Attune 0.0.1 is the first stable release.

- Refines the toolbar, metadata editing, EPUB import, and activity feedback.
- Checks for and installs updates from GitHub Releases. Builds before 0.0.1 need a one-time manual update.
- Adds experimental USB Kindle discovery, transfer, removal, and eject on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Physical-device behavior has not been validated on every platform.

See INSTALL.txt for platform requirements. macOS packages are ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized; Windows packages are not Authenticode-signed.
